Chapter 6871: Leave Your Life

Chapter 6871: Leave Your Life

Inhabitants in Golden Lamp looked out into space and saw the overlords.

Just one or two could be dealt with, but it wasn’t the case here.

“Another sure-death situation?” They turned pale.

“I will eat first!” A ravenous overlord could wait no longer.

He opened his mouth and thousands of tongues rushed into the world below.

“Not like this!” The tongues scared the hell out of the crowd.

A hand reached out and grabbed all of them, pulling the overlord down and causing him to bellow.

“Buzz.” A bear the size of a mountain appeared with surging immortal rings.

“It’s Bear Immortal!” The inhabitants prostrated in reverence.

“An immortal?!” The overlords became afraid.

“Run!” They immediately forgot their hunger and fled.

“Leave your life.” Bear Immortal roared and released devastating sound waves.

“Ahh!” The slower overlords were reduced to bloody mists while the rest kept running.

Although overlords could devour worlds, they couldn’t compete against an immortal.

“Fellow Daoist, there’s no need to be so merciless.” A golden foot descended from above, suppressing all realms.

“Big-foot Immortal!” The fleeing overlords turned around and shouted.

“Big-foot Immortal!” The big foots in Golden Lamp became frozen, especially Six-foot Monarch.

They saw a dwarf in the sky with gigantic golden feet. Spectators didn’t notice the man, only his feet.

He was an ancient being born in Golden Lamp and followed Mang later. After Mang’s death, he followed Zhao Dachui. After Heaven Pit, he joined Devouring Abyss.

He had witnessed the fall of Golden Mortal World and how it turned into Stygian.

In the mines of Golden Lamp, the influential big foots were furious upon seeing their fallen progenitor. This was the biggest humiliation of their race.

“Your abyss is here as well?” Bear Immortal asked.

“Hand over the world’s heart and we will leave.” Big-foot Immortal stared greedily at the artifact between Li Qiye’s hands.

“In your dream.” Bear Immortal grabbed a primordial ring and crushed it. Light oozed out and protected him.

“Prepare for death.” He challenged the opponent and conjured a primordial wave.

Big-foot’s expression soured as dao laws appeared beneath his feet, forming an immortal wall. Alas, he was still sent flying until the wave dissipated.

“That’s all you can do after becoming an immortal for so long?” Bear Immortal sneered arrogantly.
